description: Find Register cases by keywords (company, system, failure, e.g. 'coding agent deletes database', 'robotaxi', 'prompt injection email'), optionally filtered by world (physical, bridge, software, transaction, boundary) or by a control ID that was missing or failed. Returns short summaries with URLs.

control.description: Keep only cases where this control failed or was absent. A control ID such as C-E3; list_controls gives every ID.

limit.description: How many results to return, from 1 to 50. Default 10.

query.description: Keywords to match: a company, a system or a kind of failure, such as 'coding agent deletes database' or 'robotaxi'. A case must match at least one word. Leave out to list cases by the other filters alone.

world.description: Keep only cases in one world: physical (machines such as vehicles and robots), bridge (software acting on machines), software (software agents), transaction (agents moving money) or boundary (a machine case at the edge of the Register's scope). Leave out for all worlds.

name: search_cases
title: Search cases
